## Core Strengths
This workflow is strongest when it forces multiple lenses to analyze the same subject independently. That prevents one early opinion from dominating the whole evaluation and makes the eventual synthesis meaningfully more useful than a single long prompt response.

## Growth Opportunities
The same orchestration pattern can support adjacent evaluation workflows like proposal review, due diligence, or recurring product health checks. Those extensions mostly require prompt and artifact changes rather than a brand-new pipeline design.

## Unfair Advantages
The repo's advantage is not proprietary code. It is the combination of visible methodology, reusable skill composition, and a transparent artifact trail that a team can inspect and adapt.

## Success Conditions
The output quality must stay clearly better than a one-shot prompt. Sample runs, validated artifacts, and regression checks all help maintain that bar over time.

## Ideal Use Cases & Customer Profiles
Technical founders, PMs, and Claude Code users who want repeatable evaluation workflows are the clearest fit. They benefit most when they need both actionable criticism and something shareable with collaborators.
